searchText: Thank you both! You're welcome! Does the spec and implementation really need another two years of baking before they’re ready? <@489217181104734219> Who said this? Seems to be the common saying that after phase 0 launches, phase 1.5 is at least a year or two away Haven’t heard anyone say that. Vitalik commonly mentioned that Phase 1 should follow relatively soon after Phase 0. And working on how the merge will happen is something that can be done today.
